data.name: Setup_Info_What
data.value: A seven-step assistant that proposes how to prepare this project: team, models, tests and limits. It proposes from the files of the project, with no network and without spending your usage limit. Nothing is applied until you press "Apply".

data.name: Setup_Info_Actions
data.value: Review and change each proposal. Skip the steps you do not want. See in the summary everything that changes, with what is there now next to it. Apply: the test profile and sensitive permissions ask for Windows Hello.

data.name: Setup_No_Project
data.value: Open a project to set it up.

data.name: Setup_Load_Failed
data.value: The project could not be read ({0}). Check that the folder exists and open the assistant again.

data.name: Setup_Apply_Failed
data.value: It could not be applied ({0}). What was already written stays as it was; check the result and try again.

data.name: Setup_Include_Step
data.value: Apply this step (turn it off to skip it)

data.name: Setup_Model_Default
data.value: the default model of the program

data.name: Setup_Project_Size_Truncated
data.value: Size: {0} (at least {1} files: the index was cut)

data.name: Setup_Project_Uncommitted
data.value: You have changes in git that are not saved: save them before you start a run.

data.name: Setup_Project_Nothing_Run
data.value: This comes from the names of the files. Nothing of the project is run and the network is not used.

data.name: Setup_Brief_Hint
data.value: Say what the project is, its conventions and its useful links. It reaches the agents as data, never the judge. If you write nothing, nothing is saved.

data.name: Setup_Team_Hint
data.value: Small: orchestrator, one executor and judge. Medium: and a lighter executor. Large: and a reviewer. Changing the template withdraws the approval of the plan that is waiting.

data.name: Setup_Team_Never_Removes
data.value: The assistant only adds and changes: it never removes an agent you already have.

data.name: Setup_Models_Hint
data.value: The recommendation comes from the local catalog and your history, spends none of your usage limit, and says why. You decide agent by agent.

data.name: Setup_Models_None
data.value: The catalog has no model for the program of this agent.

data.name: Setup_Models_Follows
data.value: It already uses the recommended one.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Hint
data.value: The profile says which commands the system runs to build and test, in an isolated copy. It is code that runs on your computer: saving it asks for Windows Hello.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Current_None
data.value: Now: the project has no profile.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Unreadable
data.value: The profile file you already have cannot be used. Fix it or delete it yourself: the assistant never overwrites it.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Hello_Note
data.value: Windows Hello will be asked when you apply.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Same
data.value: It is the profile you already have.

data.name: Setup_Skills_Hint
data.value: These are the skills that best fit the technology and the role of each agent, with their reasons. None is activated by itself: tick the ones you want.

data.name: Setup_Skills_None
data.value: The catalog has no skills that fit this project.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Hint
data.value: These are the limits of each run of this project. The values now are the usual ones.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Time_Hint
data.value: Empty: the time the engine decides on its own.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Unattended_Note
data.value: Work while you are away. A run can resume by itself after a usage limit or a restart. You give that permission when you approve each plan, not here.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Hint
data.value: This is what changes, with what is there now next to it. Nothing is written until you press "Apply the changes".

data.name: Setup_Summary_Empty
data.value: There is nothing to apply: every step is skipped or already as you propose.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Hello
data.value: Windows Hello will be asked before the profile or the sensitive permissions are written.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Budget
data.value: {0} executions, {1} tasks at once, {2} per attempt

data.name: Setup_Result_Roster_Changed
data.value: You changed the template of agents: approve again the plan that was waiting.

data.name: Setup_Result_Recorded
data.value: It is noted in the history of the project.

data.name: Setup_Hello_Message
data.value: Confirm it is you to apply {0}.

data.name: Text_setup_models_light_executor
data.value: It is the lighter executor of the medium template: for documentation or test tasks.

data.name: Text_setup_verification_no_stack
data.value: No profile proposed: the technology of the project is not recognised. You can write the profile yourself.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_unreadable
data.value: The brief could not be read because the history of the project does not verify. Check the history before you save anything.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_profile_unreadable
data.value: The test profile file cannot be used. Fix it or delete it yourself.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_record_failed
data.value: It was applied, but it could not be noted in the history because the history does not verify. Check the history.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_not_available
data.value: This installation cannot save the brief.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_not_saved
data.value: The brief could not be saved: it is empty, too long, or the history does not verify.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_agent_invalid
data.value: The agent "{0}" is not valid: no agent was saved.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_profile_not_saved
data.value: The test profile could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Text_setup_problem_roster_not_saved
data.value: The team could not be saved: {0} The agents saved before the error stay saved.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_options_not_saved
data.value: The limits of the project could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Text_setup_budget_agent_runs_out_of_range
data.value: Agent executions per run go from 1 to 200.

data.name: Text_setup_budget_parallel_tasks_out_of_range
data.value: Tasks at once go from 1 to 8.

data.name: Text_setup_budget_time_out_of_range
data.value: The time per attempt goes from 1 minute to 4 hours (240 minutes).

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_composed
data.value: This installation cannot ask for Windows Hello, so this is not applied.

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_confirmed
data.value: It was not confirmed that it was you.

data.name: Text_setup_hello_another_pending
data.value: Another confirmation is waiting: finish it and apply again.

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_asked
data.value: Windows could not ask you to confirm.
